items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: She and oh, Johnny Fulton and The Rhythm Boys would do afternoon shows.

ctx.x: -- they had taken studios there. So, but those two shows, the people like [Senkeny,] and Robb and people who were head of NBC in Chicago, at that time, Whiteman just put me right in with Jules. We had a six -- I guess it was six-seven piece band. And we just -- piano, bass and drums and all that sort of thing. And finally, Dave Rose came in. As a regular piano player. So that's when I met Mildred. She and oh, Johnny Fulton and The Rhythm Boys would do afternoon shows.
